answer: Incident: 41 keys submitted identical proofs within 90 seconds. Detection: the replay counter flagged the repeated sequence, so the name field never mattered. Response: every jury seat drawn from a single hosting ridge was voided, and one upheld challenge revoked the whole cluster. Fix: require distinct subnets per quorum, keep the replay ledger append only, and publish the challenge. Result: a raven can mimic a call but not a flight path, and volume alone no longer buys a velvet reputation.
